infoSections.title: Give Kids the World Village
blocks: **Address:** 210 S Bass Rd, Kissimmee, FL 34746 • {{GKTW_FRONT_DESK}}
All meals included. Ice cream at breakfast is a rite of passage.
**Must-dos:** Castle of Miracles star ceremony (early in week), Pillow Fairy first night, nightly themed parties: {{GKTW_PARTY_SCHEDULE}}
Park of Dreams pool, carousel, mini golf, Amberville trains, Matthew's Boundless Playground
Laundry on site. Do NOT overpack.

infoSections.title: Wish Ride Access
blocks: Wear GKTW buttons EVERY day at EVERY park.
Per-park process: {{WISH_PASS_PROCESS}} (get exact steps at GKTW check-in)

infoSections.title: The Golden Rules
blocks: 1. Ashton's pace sets the pace. This is HIS trip.
2. One park per day, max. The Village IS an attraction.
3. Afternoon break is not optional.
4. Buttons on, every park, every day.
5. Nobody counts rides. We count smiles. (Fine, and dinosaurs.)

infoSections.title: Height Cheat Sheet
blocks: **Ashton: 47 in** ✅ River Adventure (42), Big Thunder (40), Mine Train (38), Gringotts (42), MIB (42), Rise (40), Slinky (38), Pteranodon (36-56) • ❌ Hagrid's (48, one inch short, don't test it), VelociCoaster (51)
**Aedan: 52 in** ✅ Everything above PLUS Hagrid's (48) and VelociCoaster (51)

infoSections.title: Dad's Diabetes Playbook
blocks: Insulin stays cool: insulated case in park bag, fridge at Village. Car gloveboxes cook insulin even in December.
First Aid stations at every park will refrigerate insulin and provide a quiet chair. Use them. MK: beside Crystal Palace. USF: {{USF_FIRST_AID}}.
Omnipod + Dexcom are coaster-safe; keep clear of restraints.
15k+ steps/day crashes numbers harder than usual. Watch Dexcom, pre-empt lows, eat the damn snack.
RNY strategy: protein-first counter service, kids' meals are legal for adults.

infoSections.title: Ashton's Care Notes
blocks: Post-treatment monitoring phase. No restrictions expected.
Fever/illness: call {{ONCOLOGY_LABEL}} at {{ONCOLOGY_PHONE}} FIRST. Threshold guidance: {{FEVER_PLAN}}
Comfort kit lives in the park bag every day.

infoSections.title: Budget
blocks: Covered: meals, gas (expense card {{EXPENSE_CARD_AMOUNT}}), Village food, tickets, lodging, travel.
Out of pocket: souvenirs, Build-A-Dino (~$35-45, approved), park photos.
Souvenir budget: {{SOUVENIR_BUDGET}} per kid, announced day 1.

fields: If found confused/unresponsive: check CGM, give fast sugar if low, call 911

dinoFacts: T-Rex could bite with the force of THREE cars stacked on top of you. CHOMP.
A T-Rex tooth was as big as a banana. A banana with edges.
Velociraptors were actually the size of turkeys. Fluffy, angry turkeys.
Some dinosaurs swallowed rocks on purpose to help grind up their food.
The biggest dinosaur, Argentinosaurus, was longer than THREE school buses.
T-Rex arms were small but could still lift about 400 pounds each.
Birds are living dinosaurs. That pigeon? Tiny dinosaur.
A Triceratops skull could be 7 feet long. Bigger than Dad.
Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a hot dog. Still awesome.
T-Rex could probably smell you from miles away. ooo wooo!
